title: Holy Land in the Time of Jesus
note: Whole picture is the map (legend box top left lies over the sea). Three symbol styles: black dots, orange Decapolis rings, purple fortress squares; no snap, because dark snap jumped from the orange rings to their label letters. Black-dot positions were taken from a dark-snap run. Philadelphia uses Rabbah 1 (Amman); Masada from the gazetteer's modern place.
